messages.subject: Javascript tutorial
parts:
I tried to follow the code in http://shiny.rstudio.com/tutorial/js-lesson1/. After installing npm and bower I was able to create the package C3, and the files and directories seem to be what is described in the text of the tutorial. 'library(C3)' completes without errors; but then 'C3Gauge("hello world")' results in the error message:

Error in (function (name, version, src, meta = NULL, script = NULL, stylesheet = NULL,  : 
  argument "version" is missing, with no default

Any suggestion as to how to solve this?

I'm using R 3.2.5, on Ubuntu 16.04. I get the same error on StatET and RStudio.

Edward

messages.author: e6d426c9552b1af9
messages.subject: Javascript tutorial
parts:
Hi,

I'm one of the authors of this tutorial. A recent update to c3.js caused a problem as its bower.json file did no longer contain a version number. The problem is that the yaml file that R creates then also misses a version line, which gave the error. We have updated the tutorial such that bower is not needed anymore. If all is well the procedure as described should work again. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Kind regards, Herman

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Javascript tutorial
parts:
You might be seeing this error because of the file path you're using. If you're using for example 

D:\Program Files\some\path

Then you need to replace all the \ with /

For example

D:/Program Files/some/path
